title: Multiple Choice - Direct Questions
description: Choose the best answer for each question.

questions.text: Which of the following describes a site where municipal garbage is buried underground?
What happens when organic matter breaks down naturally over time?
Which term refers to items designed to be thrown away after just one single use?
What should you do to an empty beverage carton before putting it into a recycling bin?
Which concept measures the total greenhouse gas emissions caused directly and indirectly by an individual?
What is the dark, nutrient-rich substance produced by decaying leaves and food scraps called?
Which potent greenhouse gas is released from decomposing organic food rotting in landfills?
Which fixture turns water on and off automatically without needing manual touch?
Which phrase describes discarded pruned tree branches, clipped hedge twigs, and fallen leaves?
Which phrase means 'over a long period of time in the future'?
